title: How to link a PDF to a Static Page
text:
## How to link a PDF to a Static Page
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000037888
Follow the steps in this article to learn how to add a PDF to a page.
1. Before linking the file to a static page, the file must be uploaded to the Media Manager. Learn more: How to Upload a File
2. Create or access the page intended for this purpose. Learn more: How to Create a Web Page
3. Navigate to My Content > Web Page Builder .
4. Locate the page and click Edit .
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12172551962/original/cSc013CrIzJg8u5JhH9HjTsG7M-bwXrUBg.png?1767060710 | alt: ]

## Text Link
Highlight the text and click Insert Link.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12125210748/original/sGcuzbPSZpGVQaHyLX_BnvATNVX8g6lvfQ.png?1683657785 | alt: ]
Enter the path to the PDF file using only the relative part of the URL, for example: /images/pdf.pdf
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12124819620/original/YvZCwOoJN4b_h9F20KtB_-SSfbsS7LeEgQ.png?1682975359 | alt: ]

## Image Link
Click the image and follow the same steps as above to link the PDF.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12124819650/original/Zq7241vum_l6Um0r-GUo2caWjCFYJi6vKA.png?1682975370 | alt: ]
6. Click Save Web Page:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12124819655/original/Qyg-t4FPml4uEH1C7FWwQR2tgEffH67o3g.png?1682975380 | alt: ]
Finally, click View Page .
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12124819680/original/FehgMGWSTacgV1zTVdSdHLS4Cl98sJXQ2w.png?1682975390 | alt: ]
